hook: Krishna became CEO of IBM on April 6, 2020, and was elected Chairman of its board effective January 1, 2021. Under his leadership IBM launched the watsonx AI and data platform in May 2023 and its Granite family of enterprise foundation models.
name: Arvind Krishna

quote.text: We don't want to constrain where people deploy it. So they want to deploy it on a large public cloud, we'll do it there. If they want to deploy it at IBM, we'll do it at IBM.
quote.context: Arvind Krishna, on IBM's enterprise AI deployment strategy, CNBC interview, December 7, 2023

reading.body:
IBM's enterprise AI strategy under Krishna prioritizes deployment flexibility across public clouds, private clouds, and on-premises infrastructure rather than forcing customers into a single platform.

This posture reflects a structural reality of enterprise software: large organizations operate heterogeneous infrastructure and will not consolidate on a single cloud provider. Krishna's watsonx platform and Granite models are built to work in this fragmented reality. For companies with existing on-premises compute and data centers, the ability to run foundation models locally matters more than access to the latest cloud-native capabilities. IBM is positioning itself as the vendor that accommodates existing infrastructure rather than demanding migration.

The strategy has direct implications for AI scaling. If enterprise deployment remains distributed across private and public infrastructure, the compute demand for AI will not concentrate in a few cloud regions but spread across thousands of data centers and customer facilities worldwide. This means the binding constraint on enterprise AI is not cloud capacity but the ability to run models on existing hardware at existing locations. It also means power and cooling requirements fragment across many buildings rather than consolidating in a few massive hyperscaler facilities.

The data does not cover whether this flexibility translates to technical parity with cloud-native alternatives, customer adoption rates, or whether Granite models compete effectively with alternatives from cloud providers or open-source communities.

timeline.event: Becomes CEO of IBM effective April 6, 2020
timeline.impact: Succeeds Ginni Rometty and begins refocusing IBM on hybrid cloud and AI.

timeline.event: Elected Chairman of IBM's board effective January 1, 2021
timeline.impact: Adds board leadership to his role as CEO.

timeline.event: Launches the watsonx AI and data platform on May 9, 2023
timeline.impact: Consolidates IBM's enterprise AI tools for building, tuning and governing foundation models.
